<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תשרי_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518914243_theRebbe_128" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_A9_D7_A8_D7_99_meluket__BH_POST_1766518914243_theRebbe_128__p006">
  <section v="15">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section expresses the hope that the joy of Sukkot will soon lead to the ultimate and complete joy of the true redemption through Moshiach.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">May it be His will that from the time of our joy of Sukkot</t>
    <t s="1">(And you shall take for yourselves... and you shall rejoice...)</t>
    <t s="2">they will come very soon to the greatest joy,</t>
    <t s="3">eternal joy upon their heads,</t>
    <t s="4">in the true and complete redemption through our righteous Moshiach,</t>
    <t s="5">may he come and redeem us and lead us upright to our land,</t>
    <t s="6">speedily in our days, literally.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section expresses the hope that the joy of Sukkot will soon lead to the ultimate and complete joy of the true redemption through Moshiach.

translations.translation: May it be His will that from the time of our joy of Sukkot
(And you shall take for yourselves... and you shall rejoice...)
they will come very soon to the greatest joy,
in the true and complete redemption through our righteous Moshiach,
may he come and redeem us and lead us upright to our land,
